expected_version.description: Project version the client last read (`get_project` returns it). The save is rejected with 409 when it no longer matches the stored version.

display_type.description: Presentation of a popup project (`modal` today).

primary_color.description: Legacy accent color; prefer `style_config.primary_color`. null clears it.

thank_you_message.description: Legacy post-submit message; prefer a `success_message` item. null clears it.

redirect_url.description: Legacy post-submit redirect; prefer `sign_up_config.success_behavior`. null clears it.

trigger_id.description: Id of the workspace trigger that controls when the popup shows; null for none.

settings_config.description: Behaviour settings (trigger, targeting, Iterable, logic, languages). Unknown keys and `iterable_integration.api_key` are dropped.

pages.description: Full page list; replaces all existing pages.

ProjectDocument.description: A whole Jule project as saved by `save_project_document`: pages with their items, project styles and behaviour settings. Validated against the generated JSON Schema, then by the save rules.

template.description: Layout template: `default` (single column) or `2-column` (left/right columns, items placed by `side`).

card_shadow.description: Card drop shadow preset: `None`, `Small`, `Medium` (default) or `Large`. Anything else falls back to Medium; raw CSS is not accepted.

font_family.description: Default font family for the whole widget.

font_family_url.description: URL of the stylesheet or font file backing `font_family`: a workspace font from branding, or a Google Fonts CSS2 stylesheet (`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=…`).

primary_color.description: Accent color used for buttons and focus states when items set none.

hide_progress.description: Legacy; the widget renders no progress indicator today, so this has no effect.

hide_previous.description: Hides every button item whose action is `previous` (CSS display none). There is no separate built-in bar; leave unset.

hide_next.description: Hides every button item whose action is `next`, including the ones in the document, so visitors cannot advance. Leave unset.

previous_button_text.description: Legacy; not used by the widget (buttons are `button` items with their own label).

next_button_text.description: Legacy; not used by the widget (buttons are `button` items with their own label).

submit_button_text.description: Legacy; not used by the widget (buttons are `button` items with their own label).

background_type.description: Whether the card background is a color or an image.

background_object_fit.description: How the background image fills the card.

justify_content.description: Main-axis distribution of the card body (`center`, `flex-start`, `space-between`).

body_flex_direction.description: Direction of the card body; banners default to `row`, everything else to `column`.

body_align_items.description: Cross-axis alignment of the card body.

left_column_object_fit.description: 2-column: fit of the left column image.

right_column_object_fit.description: 2-column: fit of the right column image.

left_column_text.description: 2-column: text shown in the left column when it holds no items.

position.description: Where a popup card sits on the screen.

overlay_opacity.description: Legacy backdrop dimness behind a popup, 0–100 percent of black (default 0). Ignored when overlay_color is set; the editor keeps it mirrored to overlay_color's alpha.

overlay_blur.description: Backdrop blur behind a popup in px (default 0).

overlay_color.description: Backdrop color behind a popup as #rrggbbaa — the alpha byte is the dimness (#00000080 = 50%). A 6-digit hex is fully opaque and hides the site. Omit for the editor default (no backdrop).

mobile_hide_left_column.description: 2-column: hide the left column on mobile.

mobile_hide_right_column.description: 2-column: hide the right column on mobile.

mobile_column_order.description: 2-column: which column comes first when stacked on mobile.

mobile_column_layout.description: 2-column: stack the columns on mobile or keep them side by side.

preference_center_header_html.description: Preference center / landing page: HTML rendered above the card.

preference_center_footer_html.description: Preference center / landing page: HTML rendered below the card.

preference_center_header_js.description: JavaScript run after the header renders.

preference_center_footer_js.description: JavaScript run after the footer renders.

preference_center_header_linked.description: Header follows the workspace branding header instead of the project's own HTML.

preference_center_footer_linked.description: Footer follows the workspace branding footer instead of the project's own HTML.

card_custom_css.description: Raw CSS appended to the card (advanced).

display_mode.description: Preference center / landing page: fill the whole page or render inside a container.

seo_og_image_url.description: Hosted page Open Graph image URL.

notification_duration.description: How long the toast stays, in ms.

notification_custom_css.description: Raw CSS appended to the toast (advanced).

loading_spinner_enabled.description: Show a spinner while a submit is in flight. Undefined means on.

i18n.description: Per-locale overrides of translatable style fields (header/footer HTML, SEO strings, button labels): locale → field → value.

ProjectStyleInfo.description: Project-level appearance: the card, its background and overlay, default typography of titles / text / buttons / inputs, the two-column layout, close button, submit notification, and preference-center chrome. Values are CSS strings unless noted; colors may be `brand:` references.

tablet.description: Overrides applied at widths up to 1024px.

mobile.description: Overrides applied at widths up to 768px (on top of `tablet`).

ResponsiveStyleConfig.description: Tablet / mobile overrides of the project styles; each bucket holds only the fields that differ.

ResponsiveStyleOverrides.description: Style fields overridden per breakpoint. The widget honours the layout and typography sizes only: card_width, card_max_width, card_height, card_padding, justify_content, body_flex_direction, body_align_items, title/desc/button/input font sizes and alignments, button/input padding, column_gap, left_column_width and the column paddings.

trigger_type.description: What opens a popup: `immediate`/`delay` (after `trigger_delay` seconds), `scroll` (at `trigger_scroll_depth` %), `exit_intent`, `manual` (`trigger_manual_condition` or the JS API), or `engagement`.

trigger_manual_condition.description: CSS selector or JS expression that opens a `manual` popup.

sign_up_config.description: How the popup is embedded and its teaser / bubble.

logic_rules.description: Page logic rules keyed by page id.

logic_fallback.description: Fallback destination per page id when no rule fires.

logic_fallback_scores.description: Score added when the fallback of a page is taken, keyed by page id.

logic_positions.description: Editor canvas positions of the logic nodes, keyed by page id (layout only).

page_iterable_fields.description: Per-page Iterable profile fields, keyed by page id.

page_iterable_actions.description: Per-page Iterable actions, keyed by page id.

email_deliverability_check.description: Block a widget submit when the email's domain provably cannot receive mail. Defaults to true in the served payload.

SettingsInfo.description: Behaviour settings: when the widget shows (trigger, targeting, schedule, frequency), how it is embedded (`sign_up_config`), Iterable, page logic and languages.

IterableActions.description: What Jule does in Iterable when a visitor submits.

display_until.description: Keep showing the widget until one of these widget events has happened for the visitor.

TargetingConditionsConfig.description: Audience targeting: rules that must pass before the widget is shown.

arrows.description: Editor canvas connectors between conditions (layout only).

type.description: What is checked (device, country, time on page, cookie, Iterable list membership, …).

logicOperator.description: How this condition combines with the previous one inside the rule.

value.description: Value compared against; list ids are numbers for `iterable_list_membership`.

TargetingConditionConfig.description: One targeting condition evaluated before the widget shows.

fromIndex.description: Index of the condition the arrow starts from.

toIndex.description: Index of the condition the arrow points to.

TargetingArrow.description: Editor canvas connector between two conditions of a rule.

start_time.description: Time of day on `start_date` the schedule begins, `HH:mm`.

end_time.description: Time of day on `end_date` the schedule ends, `HH:mm`.

active_days.description: Weekdays the widget shows (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday).

timezone.description: IANA time zone the schedule is evaluated in.

ScheduleConfig.description: When the widget may show, by date and time.

type.description: `until_completed` (default: until they submit), `once`, `always`, `multiple` (up to `max_displays`), `once_per_session`, or `cooldown` (again after `cooldown_days`).

DisplayFrequencyConfig.description: How often a popup shows to the same visitor.

api_key.description: Never stored on the project (stripped on save); the workspace connection holds the key.

list_ids.description: Iterable list ids the visitor is subscribed to.

unsubscribed_channel_ids.description: Channel ids the visitor is unsubscribed from on submit.

subscribed_message_type_ids.description: Message type ids the visitor is subscribed to on submit.

unsubscribed_message_type_ids.description: Message type ids the visitor is unsubscribed from on submit.

track_event_mappings.description: Field mappings sent as event properties.

update_profile_mappings.description: Field mappings written to the user profile.

field_mappings.description: Legacy mappings applied to every action; prefer the per-action lists.

send_on_complete.description: Send only when the whole form is completed (default) rather than per page.

send_on_question.description: Page id after which to send when not sending on complete.

preference_center_enabled.description: Preference center: load and write the visitor's Iterable subscriptions.

message_types.description: Message types available in the preference center.

channels.description: Channels available in the preference center.

use_token_validation.description: Preference center: require a signed token in the URL to identify the visitor.

token_secret.description: Secret used to sign preference-center tokens (write-only; configure via the dashboard).

sms_double_opt_in_message_type_ids.description: SMS message type ids that require double opt-in.

sms_double_opt_in_brand_name.description: Brand name used in the SMS double opt-in text.

unsubscribe_list_ids.description: List ids the visitor is unsubscribed from on submit.

subscribe_channel_ids.description: Channel ids the visitor is subscribed to on submit.

IterableIntegration.description: Per-project Iterable behaviour. The workspace holds the API key; this only says which lists, events and profile fields a submission touches.

survey_field.description: Item id or `fieldName` of the submitted answer.

iterable_field.description: Iterable data field the value is written to.

survey_field_name.description: Human-readable name of the submitted field (for the editor).

actions.description: Which Iterable actions this mapping applies to.

IterableFieldMapping.description: Maps one submitted field to an Iterable profile field or event property.

IterableCustomField.description: A constant key/value sent to Iterable with every submission.

id.description: Iterable message type id.

subscriptionPolicy.description: Iterable subscription policy of the message type.

IterableMessageTypeInfo.description: An Iterable message type mirrored into the project for preference rendering.

id.description: Iterable channel id.

IterableChannelInfo.description: An Iterable channel mirrored into the project for preference rendering.

type.description: Unsubscribe from the campaign's channel, from all email, or from `channel_ids`.

OneClickUnsubscribeBehavior.description: Behaviour of the one-click unsubscribe link in a preference center.

display_mode.description: `popup` (modal), `inline` (in the page flow), `bubble` (floating button) or `banner` (edge bar).

banner_show_close_button.description: Show a close button on the banner. Undefined means shown.

bubble_icon_type.description: Use a custom icon image in the bubble.

teaser_style.description: Teaser shape (a popup's teaser reuses the bubble styling).

teaser_saved_rect_width.description: Editor memory of the last rectangle width.

teaser_saved_rect_height.description: Editor memory of the last rectangle height.

teaser_saved_circle_size.description: Editor memory of the last circle size.

teaser_display_setting.description: When the teaser shows: after the popup is closed, before the form, or both.

teaser_anchored.description: Popup opens anchored to the teaser instead of centered. Undefined means anchored.

teaser_enabled.description: Show a teaser that re-opens a closed popup.

teaser_show_close_button.description: Show a close button on the teaser.

teaser_mirror_text.description: Teaser text mirrors the first heading of the form.

success_behavior.description: After submit: show a message, redirect, or hide the widget.

i18n.description: Per-locale overrides of `bubble_text` and `success_message`: locale → field → value.

SignUpConfig.description: How a popup project is embedded and the teaser / bubble that opens it.

id.description: Stable rule id.

destination.description: Where to go when the rule fires.

score.description: Points added to the running score when the rule fires.

PageLogicRule.description: A page logic rule: when all conditions hold, go to `destination`.

field.description: `fieldName` of the input or rating the condition reads (or `__score__`).

LogicCondition.description: One condition of a page logic rule; reads a submitted answer.

LogicOperator.description: Comparison used by page logic conditions.

LogicConditionValue.description: Value a logic condition compares against.

LogicDestination.description: Where a logic rule sends the visitor when it fires.

pageId.description: Id of the page to show.

LogicTerminal.description: Submit the answers (`submit`) or close the widget (`close`).

pageId.description: Id of the page to show after submitting.

LogicSubmitAndPage.description: Submit the answers, then show another page.

LogicSubmitAndRedirect.description: Submit the answers, then open a URL.

CanvasPosition.description: A position on the logic editor canvas.

id.description: Stable field id.

source.description: Static text or the running quiz score.

PageIterableField.description: A profile field written to Iterable when the visitor reaches a page.

value.description: The text written to the field.

actions.description: Update the profile and/or fire a custom event with the page's fields.

enabledLocales.description: Locale codes the visitor can switch between.

directions.description: Text direction per locale; unlisted locales are `ltr`.

LocaleConfig.description: Languages of the widget. Translations live in the `i18n` maps of items, styles and settings.

title.description: Page title (shown in the editor and progress indicator).

items.description: Items on the page, top-level and nested alike (nesting is expressed by `parent_id`).

type.description: Selects the variant: one of text, button, input, logo, group, checkbox-group, preference-category, html-block, rating, success_message, flex, coupon, icon.

error_style_info.description: Styles applied in the error state (`success_message` items).

side.description: `2-column` template only: which column the item sits in.

alignSelf.description: Cross-axis alignment of this item inside its flex parent.

justifySelf.description: Inline-axis alignment of this item inside its grid cell.

contentAlign.description: Coupon block: horizontal alignment of its content. Default `center`.

pin.description: Stack mode, child: anchor this item is pinned to inside its Stack parent. `none` keeps it in normal flow.

pinOffsetY.description: Stack mode, child: vertical offset from the pin anchor, CSS length (may be negative).

gridTemplateRows.description: Grid mode, parent: row track list, space-joined.

gridArea.description: Grid mode, child: named area from the parent's map; wins over the spans.

gridSpanColumns.description: Grid mode, child: number of columns to span (auto-flow only).

gridSpanRows.description: Grid mode, child: number of rows to span (auto-flow only).

columnGap.description: Flex / grid parent: horizontal gap between children, CSS length.

suggestionStyle.description: `email` inputs: styles of the typo-suggestion line shown under the field.

mobile.description: Overrides applied at widths up to 768px (on top of `tablet`).

success_text.description: Text shown above the revealed code.

expiry_screen.description: Screen shown when the coupon has expired.

teaser_bg.description: Retired "before submit" teaser background; read only as a fallback for `label_*`.

code_border_radius.description: Code box corner radius in px.

additionalProperties.description: Any other `<section>_<property>` key from the coupon style panel.
